name: Transport One
description: Transport One was the designation of a Longbeam cruiser of the Galactic Republic's Republic Defense Coalition that assisted in the Republic and Jedi Order's raid on the Korvix Vorn, a prison ship of the Nihil marauders, intended to serve as a transport to rescue the prisoners. However, the Longbeam took significant damage from the Korvix Vorn topside blister bomb cannons, and Admiral Pevel Kronara ordered it to retreat. As a result, the smaller Republic and Jedi starfighters had to retrieve the prisoners individually.
